Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for scheduling the POC kickoff. Before we lock the date, quick preflight to make sure the onsite vs. virtual options work for you and your security/infra team: 

1) Attendee list and roles (onsite vs remote) — we need names for visitor badges and a point of contact for building access.
2) Recording/streaming — we typically request consent to record the hands-on session for internal follow-up and to collect prompts for evals. If TitanPay requires redaction or an approval process, please let us know.
3) AV/room needs for onsite — projector, HDMI adaptors, microphone? We can bring our own hub but want to confirm what the room provides.
4) Load-testing window — Sean will run an end-to-end routing/load test during the workshop; please confirm if infra@titanpay.com can provide a test endpoint or if we should use a sandbox.

Attached: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf and our AV checklist. Proposed kickoff slots are Jan 12 or Jan 18 (we can do hybrid). If you prefer fully virtual, we’ll provide a secure stream and recording permissions flow.

If you can reply with the attendee names and whether TitanPay requires a visitor NDA, I’ll coordinate room booking and calendar invites.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
